commands.command:
. ~/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4/export.sh >/dev/null; PORT=$(python3 - <<'PY'
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial and p.vid==0x303A]
if len(m)!=1: raise SystemExit(f'expected exactly one emulator C6, got {[p.device for p in m]}')
print(m[0].device)
PY
); echo EMU_PORT=$PORT; echo '=== EXIT ROM VIA HARD RESET ==='; python -m esptool --chip esp32c6 -p "$PORT" --before no_reset --after hard_reset chip_id; sleep 3; echo '=== CAPTURE APP LOG 20s ==='; python3 - <<'PY'
import time
import serial
from serial.tools import list_ports
serial_no='40:4C:CA:5D:01:D8'
deadline=time.time()+15
port=None
while time.time()<deadline:
    m=[p for p in list_ports.comports() if p.serial_number==serial_no and p.vid==0x303A]
    if len(m)==1:
        port=m[0].device
        break
    time.sleep(0.5)
if not port: raise SystemExit('emulator port did not re-enumerate after hard reset')
print('APP_PORT='+port)
lines=[]
with serial.Serial(port,115200,timeout=0.25) as s:
    end=time.time()+20
    while time.time()<end:
        b=s.readline()
        if b:
            t=b.decode('utf-8','replace').rstrip('\r\n')
            lines.append(t)
            print(t)
print('APP_LINES='+str(len(lines)))
PY
